public_rationale: Anthropic's filing challenges the literal claim of virtually no assets: it reports substantial assets and liquid investments. Supplier dependence is also documented. These findings do not settle the wider assertions about customer instability, costs and inability to pay bills for both companies. The asset definition and accounting basis are unspecified, so the contextual counterevidence does not justify a definitive or mixed score under the matching rules.
limitations: Financial assets do not answer the narrower question of owned infrastructure collateral.
Credit-covenant compliance is not proof that all future obligations are affordable.
The evidence is substantially stronger for Anthropic than for OpenAI.
The filing became public after the post but before the evaluation cutoff and describes an earlier period.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI and Anthropic have high concentration risk, brittle economics, virtually no assets, have shown little ability to cut costs, and cannot afford their bills.

statement.excerpt: Both of them have massive amounts of concentration risk, unstable customers, brittle economics, own virtually no assets, and have demonstrated little to no ability to reduce their costs outside of questionable accounting that doesn’t change the fact that they cannot afford their bills.

from_speaker: little to no ability to reduce their costs
our_interpretation: Use the first half of 2026 as the latest completed half-year that could reasonably have been reported before publication; assess balance-sheet quantities at June 30.
Concentration risk includes reliance on major customers, distribution channels and compute suppliers.
The ordinary reading of assets includes cash, investments and owned property. The broader post's emphasis on data centers also permits a narrower reading about infrastructure available as collateral.
Cannot afford their bills means insufficient available liquidity and receipts to meet obligations when due. Accounting losses or large future commitments alone do not establish this.
Cost reduction means a comparable reduction in actual expenses or unit costs, rather than merely relabeling expenses.
criteria.support_condition: Records for both companies establish substantial concentration, customer fragility, weak operating economics, negligible relevant assets, little genuine cost improvement and liquidity inadequate for bills falling due.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records materially refute one or more asserted weaknesses, such as substantial relevant owned assets, adequate liquidity for obligations due, diversified durable customers or demonstrated genuine cost reductions.
